item.title: Incarico post-doc: Ca' Foscari University of Venice - postdoctoral assignement “STARLINE- STerile Automatic Robotic Line for Advanced Solutions” (Univ. VENEZIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 13:00
Institution: Univ. VENEZIA, Venezia
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-07 Chimica farmaceutica, tossicologica, nutraceutico-alimentare, delle fermentazioni e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

The fellowship holder will carry out research within the STARLine project, focusing specifically on the development and validation of methodologies for the biological, microbiological, and chemical- physical monitoring of sterile processes; the study of pharmaceutical product stability and interactions between the formulation and the primary glass container; as well as the analysis and interpretation of experimental data and the standardization of relevant protocols. They will also collaborate on the preparation of technical-scientific documentation and project deliverables. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Identification of emerging allergens in the durum wheat supply chain (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-04 23:59
Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-05 Chimica organica

The focus of this project is the study of certain allergens (mustard, lupine, soy) selected because they have a non-negligible probability of being present in the durum wheat supply chain following field contamination, in relation to farming practices and climatic conditions. Special emphasis will be placed on the development and subsequent application of innovative methods based on the LC-MS technique, capable of overcoming the limitations of the other techniques commonly used.
